notes.title: Hatsune Miku VR update, new DLC, sale and huge giveaway!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526477/b7058c944b684b73813de1139bf92ee9ae9a650e.png[/img]

First up, Hatsune Miku VR just got an update and new DLC bringing the total songs up to 19!

[h1]Update[/h1]
[list][*][b]Stage Select Screen[/b]
Added a costume and stick select (new Snow Miku & Negi available)
[*][b]Music Video mode[/b]
New song select screen: choose 8 songs to watch as a playlist with new costume select, stick select and stage select too.
[*][b]Sound enhancements[/b]
Rebalanced volume levels and changed in-game music to 3D sound.
[*][b]New free song[/b]
STELLA (by KotsubaneP)
[*][b]New free stage[/b]
Snow stage
[/list]

[h1]Sale[/h1]
And if that wasn't enough, we also have a sale on!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/707300/

[h1]Contest[/h1]
And to celebrate the update, DLC and launching on the Oculus store, we have a contest running on Gleam with prizes which include official Miku goodies, tickets to the Hatsune Miku Expo in Hong Kong in July and more!
Check the link below to enter:
https://gleam.io/bJt0s/hatsune-miku-vr-oculus-rift-experiences-launch

notes.title: Nurse Love Syndrome is out!
notes.notes:
The heartfelt love story between nurses, Nurse Love Syndrome, is now available! First week special offer includes the soundtrack and a 10% discount, make sure to grab it now.

To thank all the fans worldwide, and celebrate the first release ever in 4 languages, the game artist drew this:

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526477/6c3d8401039df6eb6dfcd63883a8aa2a6be5401a.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526477/84ebd520c3fe33a8c50e3e21081ec9576b3cafd4.jpg[/img][/url]

Hoping you enjoy the game as mush as we did.

Cheers

notes.title: Scar of the Doll Update 4/26
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!  Thanks for playing Scar of the Doll.  This update contains the following fixes:

- Fixed an error In the English version of the game, where the Mac displays a message in Japanese 

- Fixed an error where you can enter rooms and initiate obsolete conversations that appeared earlier in the game with certain characters
